item.title: Consumer Groups, Offsets, and the __consumer_offsets Topic
item.description: What Is a Consumer Group? A consumer group is a set of consumer instances that jointly consume a topic. Kafka assigns each partition to exactly one consumer within the group at a time. This is what enables parallel processing: multiple consumers in the same group read different partitions simultaneously. flowchart LR subgraph Topic["Topic: orders — 4 partitions"] P0["Partition 0"] P1["Partition 1"] P2["Partition 2"] P3["Partition 3"] end subgraph CG["Consumer Group: inventory-service"] C1["
